validate.scope: Structure, internal links, source-footnote matching, migration values and arithmetic; not independent factual or legal certification.

validate_visitor_index.scope: Local references, provenance linkage and seed evidence-state controls; not source accuracy or current operation.

validate_maritime.scope: Internal references, explicit evidence classes, metric/graph equality and arithmetic; no certification of historical claims.

validate_growth_journeys.scope: Sources, units, period comparability, arithmetic and evidence-state safeguards; no independent verification of reported outcomes.

validate_statistics.scope: Structure, references and arithmetic; not independent source verification or human editorial review.

validate_homestays.scope: Stage and qualifier fields, register references, conflict holds and policy arithmetic; not legal certification, source authentication or proof of demand.

validate_classification.scope: Editorial subject IDs, topic coverage and agreement with related-reading links; not source verification, causation or publication approval.

validate_collections.scope: Collection links, observation references, stage compatibility, public-card data agreement and one settlement reconciliation; not independent source verification or publication approval.

validate_prd.scope: Requirement IDs, phase/basis/ADR references, version pointers and snapshot checksums; not feature acceptance, formal approval or factual certification.

validate_creations.scope: Referential integrity, explicit credits and missing-value semantics; not independent source verification or public approval.

validate_sports.scope: Identity, event scope, attribution and historical/current separation; not factual certification.

validate_research_map.scope: Inventory references and reuse coverage; not factual equivalence, source freshness or publication approval.
